claims.claim: All companies registered at Companies House must file a confirmation statement at least once every 12 months.
claims.quote: You must review your records and file at least one confirmation statement every 12 months.
claims.note: The guidance says every company must file at least one confirmation statement every 12 months.

claims.claim: LLPs and eligible partnerships must also file a confirmation statement at least once every 12 months.
claims.note: The sources talk only about companies and never mention LLPs or partnerships.

claims.quote: It costs £50 to file your confirmation statement online, and £110 by post.
claims.note: The source gives £50 online and £110 by post, not £34.

claims.claim: The filing fee can be waived for dormant companies in some circumstances.
claims.note: The sources say dormant companies must file but say nothing about waiving the fee.

sign_in_on_page: Companies House password and authentication code
